text_block_list.text:
One day, after Симболи Рудольф has a
number of
victories under her belt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I drop by the student council office to
discuss the
raffle prize we had previously
won together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Save it until I have earned the holiday.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As for when that is, I leave it to your
discretion. I
know that you will judge me
fair and true.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I see... So you believe the time has
come.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
You've achieved so much during our time
together.

text_block_list.text:
I know she's still a long way from where
she hopes
to be, but she has more than
earned a break.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Very well. I trust your judgment.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I invited the other
student
council members?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I have been working hard, they have
been
working even harder. They too
deserve a chance
to relax.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. How could you
possibly
unwind with us around?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
We can handle things here just fine
while you're
away.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув... Brian...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, we're through the busy
season.
Leave us to take care of the rest
and let your hair
down a little.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Well, how could I refuse an offer like
that? Thank
you, both of you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer... It seems we have a
relaxing
vacation ahead of us.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
With that, we start getting ready for our
trip.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: (not displayed in-game)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... That was delightful.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry if I kept you waiting, but I
relished every
moment of the bath.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: As long as you enjoyed yourself.

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate that. I must say, these hot
springs are
marvelous.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Steam does wonders to clear my mind.
As my
thoughts dissolve in the heat,
unexpected truths
come into focus.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: It has been a deeply fulfilling experience... Although, I may have stayed in the water a little too long.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It is nothing to worry about. Although I
would like
to rest a little before we eat.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What do you say we head outside to get
some
fresh air?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: You're looking a little flushed yourself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What a delightful breeze. Perfect for
cooling off
after a long soak.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: What were you thinking about in there?

text_block_list.text:
All manner of things. The mundane and
the
metaphysical, the meaningful and
the trivial...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And I recall coming up with the most
marvelous
puns... or so I thought at the
time, at least.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thoughts come hazily in the hot springs,
I've
found.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But there is one thing that I remember
clearly.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The path we have walked shines brightly
in the
dark, even when the moon is
hidden.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We have certainly faced our fair share of

adversity, but I would not trade it for
the world.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I wish for nothing more than to forge
onward by
your side and follow this
luminescent path far into
the distance.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I hope you are prepared to do the same.
After all,
I have no intention of letting
you go.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: And the same to you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Haha... With all that said, I feel a little
flustered.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Could we stay out here a little longer?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We discuss all sorts of things after that,
both
meaningful and trivial.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I sense that Симболи Рудольф and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
